cards.text: Ezekiel, a prophet, is in the middle of a vision of a temple, and he's telling it himself. A man with a measuring rod (Ezekiel 40:3) has been walking him all over it, wall after wall after WALL (Ezekiel 40:5-42:20), and friend, if that were me, I'd be hopping behind him on my gold base going "ARE WE THERE YET?" Now the man brings Ezekiel back to the gate that faces east.

cards.question: Ezekiel is back at the temple gate when he sees the glory of the God of Israel coming. Which direction is it coming from?

cards.text: His voice is like the roar of many waters, and the earth shines with His glory. Friend, the brightest thing in my old junk drawer was a birthday candle somebody used once.
Ezekiel says he's seen something like this before. This vision is like the one he saw when He came to destroy the city, and like the visions he saw by the River Kebar.

cards.question: Standing before the glory of the God of Israel, Ezekiel ___.
With Ezekiel facedown, the glory of the LORD enters the temple through the gate facing east. True or false?

cards.text: Then the Spirit lifts Ezekiel up and brings him into the inner court. Me? I hop everywhere I go, base and all, and I STILL show up out of breath.

cards.question: Ezekiel is in the inner court now, and the ___ of the LORD fills the temple.

cards.text: The man is still standing right beside Ezekiel, so it's not him talking. Someone is speaking to Ezekiel from INSIDE the temple, and friend, that's the moment you put your phone face down and LISTEN.

cards.question: A voice from inside the temple tells Ezekiel, "Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet…" What does He say He will do there?

answers.text: Rule from there for a season

cards.text: He says the house of Israel will never again defile His holy name, neither they nor their kings. Before, they put their threshold right next to His, with only a wall between Him and them.

cards.question: The voice from inside the temple says that when Israel and their kings built right up against His temple, He overlooked the abominations they committed. True or false?

cards.text: He says they defiled His holy name by their abominations, so He consumed them in His anger. Then He says, "Now let them remove far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will dwell among them forever."

cards.question: The voice from inside the temple says Israel defiled His holy name. Now He tells Ezekiel to describe the temple to the people of Israel, so that they may be ___ of their iniquities.
If the people of Israel are ashamed of all they've done, the voice from the temple tells Ezekiel to write the temple's design down where they can see it. True or false?
Then the voice from the temple gives Ezekiel the law of the temple. What does it say about all the temple's surrounding territory on top of the mountain?

answers.text: It will belong to the king
It will be open for trade

cards.text: Then the voice gives the altar's measurements in long cubits: a gutter at the base, ledges stepping up, a square hearth twelve cubits each way with four horns, and steps facing east. Friend, I measure chocolate chips by the mustache-full.

Then the Lord GOD gives the statutes for the altar's first days, served by the Levitical priests from the family of Zadok, a priest in King David's day (2 Samuel 8:17): seven days of sin offerings and burnt offerings, blood on the altar's horns and salt on the burnt offerings, until the altar is cleansed and consecrated. Seven days of getting the altar ready, friend, and I get antsy waiting ten minutes for my oven to preheat.

cards.question: After seven days of atonement for the altar, from the eighth day on, the priests present the people's burnt offerings and peace offerings. What does the Lord GOD say He will do then?

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend. Keep your apron on, because this vision is NOT done yet.
